places.name: Blue Duck's camp on the Canadian
places.note: Blue Duck abandons Lorena to the Kiowas, who mutilate the dying Dog Face; Augustus and July charge in and Augustus kills the whole gang.
places.location_hint: on the plains a short way from the Canadian River, Texas Panhandle, some eight miles downriver (east) of July's canyon-mouth camp

places.name: Canadian River
places.note: Blue Duck rides off toward it; Augustus warns that a dangerous man is loose along it.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Augustus tells shaken July this carnage differs from an Arkansas saloon brawl.

groups.label: Augustus and Lorena
groups.at: Blue Duck's camp on the Canadian
groups.hint: at the outlaw camp near the Canadian; Lorena too weak to travel fast

groups.label: July Johnson
groups.hint: riding back west over the ridges toward his party's canyon-mouth camp

groups.label: Blue Duck
groups.hint: rode off from the camp toward the river, whereabouts unknown
